caption:
Using AI to write code is normal now. Teams expect it.

What gets noticed in a code review or an interview is whether you understand what got written. Why this hook, why this query, what happens when the API fails.

One habit fixes most of it: before you commit AI-written code, explain each line to yourself out loud.

If you can't, you're not done yet.

For Best Frontend Resources visit https://allahabadi.dev created by Frontend Master

altText:
AI isn't replacing junior developers.

It's replacing juniors who [[can't explain their own code]].
